nlin-01-c2.text: University of British Columbia, Department of Mathematics (2023). MATH 552 (2023W1) Lecture 8: Linearization and hyperbolicity. UBC MATH 552 lecture notes.
nlin-01-c2.quote: a dynamical system at a hyperbolic equilibrium or fixed point is locally topologically equivalent to its linearization at the origin
nlin-01-c2.claim: The Hartman–Grobman theorem guarantees that, near a hyperbolic fixed point (no eigenvalues with zero real part), the nonlinear and linearized flows are topologically equivalent.

nlin-01-c3.text: Federico Zadra, Alessandro Bravetti, Marcello Seri (2021). Geometric numerical integration of Liénard systems via a contact Hamiltonian approach. arXiv:2005.03951 [math.NA].
nlin-01-c3.quote: In particular, the theorem above implies that the van der Pol equation (4) with ε > 0 has a unique, stable limit cycle.
nlin-01-c3.claim: The Van der Pol oscillator ẍ - μ(1 - x²)ẋ + x = 0 has a stable limit cycle for any μ > 0.

nlin-07-c3.text: Yoshiki Kuramoto, Dorjsuren Battogtokh (2002). Coexistence of Coherence and Incoherence in Nonlocally Coupled Phase Oscillators. arXiv.
nlin-07-c3.quote: Under suitable conditions, peculiar patterns emerge in which a quasi-continuous array of identical oscillators separates sharply into two domains, one composed of mutually synchronized oscillators with unique frequency and the other composed of desynchronized oscillators with distributed frequencies.
nlin-07-c3.claim: In 2002 Kuramoto and Battogtokh discovered that in a ring of identical oscillators with non-local coupling, the system spontaneously splits into a synchronous group and an incoherent group, even though every oscillator is identical and the coupling is symmetric.

nlin-08-c3.text: L. Khaykovich, F. Schreck, G. Ferrari, T. Bourdel, J. Cubizolles, L. D. Carr, Y. Castin, C. Salomon (2002). Formation of a Matter-Wave Bright Soliton. Science 296, 1290-1293 (arXiv:cond-mat/0205378).
nlin-08-c3.quote: We report the production of matter-wave solitons in an ultracold lithium 7 gas.
nlin-08-c3.claim: matter-wave solitons in attractive Bose–Einstein condensates (first observed in lithium-7, 2002)
